from pathlib import Path
import subprocess

unit=Path.home()/".config/systemd/user/prediction-chat-wake.service"
text=unit.read_text(encoding="utf-8") if unit.is_file() else ""
if "bridge_server.py" in text:
    print("WAKE_ENTRYPOINT=BRIDGE_SERVER_PY",flush=True)
    raise SystemExit(31)
if "bridge_server_continuation.py" in text:
    print("WAKE_ENTRYPOINT=CONTINUATION_SOURCE",flush=True)
    raise SystemExit(32)
if "bridge_server_status_compaction.py" in text:
    print("WAKE_ENTRYPOINT=STATUS_COMPACTION",flush=True)
    raise SystemExit(33)
if "bridge_server_session_bootstrap.py" in text:
    print("WAKE_ENTRYPOINT=SESSION_BOOTSTRAP",flush=True)
    raise SystemExit(34)
if "bridge_server_hardened.py" in text:
    print("WAKE_ENTRYPOINT=HARDENED",flush=True)
    raise SystemExit(35)

print("WAKE_ENTRYPOINT=UNKNOWN",flush=True)
raise SystemExit(36)
